title: Our first game ever: my son drew everything on paper, and we're bringing it to life from zero
author: ElectronicSetting711
selftext:
Hi! We're making our very first game, learning game programming and 3D modeling for the first time.

My son drew everything on paper: the robots, the bosses, the worlds. All the ideas in his head, we're turning them into a real game, step by step. We're starting completely from zero.

We just started our YouTube channel, and this is our first video:

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Y696QGb-s8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2Y696QGb-s8)

Right now we're adding a lot of visual improvements, and we hope to release a demo on the Play Store next week!

Any advice for beginners is very welcome!

\-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Estamos creando nuestro primer juego, aprendiendo desde cero a programar videojuegos y a modelar en 3D. Mi hijo dibujó todo en papel y estamos llevando sus ideas 100% al juego. Ahora estamos agregando muchas mejoras visuales y esperamos lanzar una demo en la Play Store la próxima semana. 

¡Cualquier consejo es bienvenido!
